name: G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: The default AM5 kit — 6000 CL30 is the Ryzen sweet spot. Model F5-6000J3038F16GX2-TZ5NR. Sept-2026 pricing is ~5x the $105 seen in late 2024.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL28
notes: Binned-tighter version of the 6000 CL30 kit (F5-6000J2836G16GX2-TZ5NR). Small real-world gain over CL30 for a ~10% premium.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo RGB 64GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: Dual-rank 2x32 kit (F5-6000J3040G32GX2-TZ5NR); slightly looser tRCD/tRP than the 2x16. Price went from ~$200 (Jan 2025) to over $1,000 in 2026.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 Royal Neo RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL26
notes: Halo AM5 kit with crystalline light bar and electroplated heatspreader (F5-6000J2636G16GX2-TR5NG/TR5NS). Lowest CAS you can buy at 6000.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB 32GB DDR5-6400 CL32
notes: Intel-oriented sibling (F5-6400J3239G16GX2-TZ5RK). Runs fine on AM5 via XMP but 6400 is above the safe 1:1 FCLK ratio for many Ryzen 7000 chips.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB 32GB DDR5-7200 CL34
notes: Mainstream high-speed Intel kit (F5-7200J3445G16GX2-TZ5RK). Needs a 2-DIMM or good 4-DIMM board on Raptor Lake / Arrow Lake.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB 32GB DDR5-8000 CL38
notes: One of the first retail 8000 kits (F5-8000J3848H16GX2-TZ5RK). Launched at $530 in Dec 2022; the 2026 crunch put it back above launch price.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB 48GB DDR5-8000 CL40
notes: Non-binary 24GB-per-stick kit (F5-8000J4048F24GX2-TZ5RK). 8000 at 1.35V because 24Gb M-die scales well on voltage.

name: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB 96GB DDR5-6400 CL32
notes: Highest-capacity two-DIMM enthusiast kit (F5-6400J3239F48GX2-TZ5RK). Popular for local-AI / workstation builds; ~$16/GB in Sept 2026.

name: G.Skill Flare X5 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: Same bin as the Trident Z5 Neo 6000 CL30 without RGB and in a 33mm low-profile heatsink (F5-6000J3038F16GX2-FX5). Best G.Skill value on AM5.

name: G.Skill Ripjaws S5 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: Low-profile Intel-leaning budget line (F5-6000J3040F16GX2-RS5K). Later production runs added EXPO on some SKUs; check the exact part number.

name: G.Skill Ripjaws V 16GB DDR4-3600 CL16
notes: The classic AM4 / 12th-gen value kit (F4-3600C16D-16GVKC). DDR4 more than doubled in 2026 as fabs shifted to DDR5/HBM.

name: G.Skill Ripjaws V 32GB DDR4-3600 CL16
notes: F4-3600C16D-32GVKC. Dual-rank 16GB sticks; the most common 32GB DDR4 upgrade for Ryzen 5000.

name: G.Skill Ripjaws V 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: F4-3200C16D-16GVKB. Cheapest still-in-production G.Skill DDR4 kit.

name: G.Skill Trident Z Neo 32GB DDR4-3600 CL16
notes: F4-3600C16D-32GTZNC. RGB AMD-tuned DDR4; still listed at Best Buy / Micro Center in 2026.

name: G.Skill Trident Z Neo 16GB DDR4-3600 CL16
notes: F4-3600C16D-16GTZNC uses the 16-16-16-36 bin, which historically meant Samsung B-die. Availability is thinning.

name: Corsair Vengeance 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMK32GX5M2B6000Z30 (grey, EXPO) / CMK32GX5M2B6000C30 (black, XMP). Low-profile 35mm heatsink; Corsair does not disclose the die.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMH32GX5M2B6000Z30K. Corsair's best seller; ten-zone RGB via iCUE. Listed $550 on Amazon and Newegg in early Sept 2026.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL36
notes: CMH32GX5M2E6000C36. The looser-timing budget RGB kit; Newegg's July-2026 buying guide pick at $480.

name: Corsair Vengeance 64GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMK64GX5M2B6000Z30. Dual-rank 2x32; Tom's index cites 64GB DDR5-6000 up 470%+ year over year.

name: Corsair Vengeance 96GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMK96GX5M2B6000Z30. 2x48 non-binary kit for workstation / local-AI use. Price roughly tracks the DDR5 median of ~$16-17/GB.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5-6400 CL32
notes: CMH32GX5M2B6400C32. Intel-tuned 6400; Corsair.com direct price in late Aug 2026 was $459.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB DDR5-7200 CL34
notes: CMH32GX5M2B7200C34. 7200 CL34 tier tracked at ~$630 minimum in Sept 2026.

name: Corsair Dominator Titanium RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMP32GX5M2B6000Z30. Corsair's flagship with swappable top bars; 57mm tall so check cooler clearance.

name: Corsair Dominator Titanium RGB 64GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: CMP64GX5M2B6000Z30. Premium 64GB; roughly $20/GB in Sept 2026.

name: Corsair Dominator Titanium RGB 48GB DDR5-7200 CL36
notes: CMP48GX5M2B7200C36. Intel-only 2x24 kit; Arrow Lake / Raptor Lake target.

name: Corsair Vengeance LPX 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: CMK16GX4M2E3200C16. The best-selling DDR4 kit of all time; Corsair now also markets EXPO support on the E-suffix revision.

name: Corsair Vengeance LPX 32GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: CMK32GX4M2E3200C16. Corsair.com listed $249.99 (from $296.99) in early Sept 2026; was $60-90 in Oct 2025.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB Pro 32GB DDR4-3600 CL18
notes: CMW32GX4M2D3600C18. Still-sold RGB DDR4; CL18 bin is what remains in stock in 2026.

name: Corsair Vengeance RGB Pro 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: CMW16GX4M2C3200C16. Entry RGB DDR4 kit.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: KF560C30BBEK2-32. EXPO-certified, 34.9mm tall. Price tracker showed $512 (Amazon) to $590 (Newegg) in late Aug 2026; was $113 in Mar 2025.

name: Kingston Fury Beast RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: KF560C30BBEAK2-32. RGB version with Kingston's IR sync; 42.2mm tall.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB DDR5-6000 CL36
notes: KF560C36BBEK2-32. The CL36 bin was $116-150 on Slickdeals in 2025; ~$500 in 2026.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB DDR5-5200 CL40
notes: KF552C40BBK2-32. Original 2021 Fury Beast DDR5 bin; still sold as an entry kit. CompSource listed $573 in Aug 2026, Amazon lower.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 64GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: KF560C30BBEK2-64. Dual-rank 64GB EXPO kit.

name: Kingston Fury Renegade 32GB DDR5-7200 CL38
notes: KF572C38RSK2-32. Kingston's top Intel bin; 39.2mm tall, silver/black heatsink.

name: Kingston Fury Renegade RGB 32GB DDR5-6400 CL32
notes: KF564C32RSAK2-32. 6400 CL32 RGB Renegade.

name: Kingston Fury Renegade 96GB DDR5-6000 CL32
notes: KF560C32RSK2-96. 2x48 workstation kit. eBay listings reached $2,600 in Sept 2026; retail closer to $1,600.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: KF432C16BBK2/16. MSRP was $41; the 2026 DDR4 spot-price spike (DDR4 chips at a record ~$42 each) pushed kit prices to ~$110.

name: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: KF432C16BBK2/32 (also sold as KF432C16BB1K2/32 revision).

name: Kingston Fury Beast 32GB DDR4-3600 CL18
notes: KF436C18BBK2/32. Kingston's 3600 DDR4 bin is CL18, not CL16.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: FF3D532G6000HC30DC01. MemRadar: $559.99 on Amazon and Newegg 5 Sept 2026, up 14% in 30 days; all-time low $85 (Jul 2023).

name: TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB 32GB DDR5-6400 CL32
notes: FF3D532G6400HC32ADC01. Same heatsink as the 6000 kit.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Vulcan 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: FLBD532G6000HC30DC01. Non-RGB low-profile Vulcan; one of the cheaper name-brand 6000 CL30 kits.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Xtreem 32GB DDR5-8000 CL38
notes: FFXD532G8000HC38DDC01. TeamGroup explicitly markets this as A-die. Non-RGB; an ARGB variant (FF9D) exists.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Xtreem 48GB DDR5-8000 CL38
notes: FFXD548G8000HC38EDC01. 24Gb M-die 2x24 kit; ~$16/GB in Sept 2026.

name: TeamGroup Elite 32GB DDR5-5600 CL46
notes: TED532G5600C46DC01. Bare green-PCB JEDEC kit with no XMP/EXPO; cheapest way into DDR5.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Vulcan Z 16GB DDR4-3200 CL16
notes: TLZGD416G3200HC16CDC01. Long-running budget DDR4 kit.

name: TeamGroup T-Force Xtreem ARGB 16GB DDR4-3600 CL14
notes: TF10D416G3600HC14CDC01. Tom's Hardware's cheapest DDR4-3600 C14 pick at $169.99 (Newegg only). B-die bin.

name: Crucial Pro 32GB DDR5-6000 CL36
notes: CP2K16G60C36U5B. Micron's own die in a 31.5mm low-profile heatsink. $83 on Amazon in 2025; ~$400-440 in 2026.

name: Crucial Pro 64GB DDR5-6000 CL40
notes: CP2K32G60C40U5B. 64GB Crucial Pro OC bin is CL40, not CL36.

name: Crucial 32GB DDR5-5600 CL46
notes: CT2K16G56C46U5. Plain JEDEC 5600 kit. $65 in Aug 2023; $439 in Sept 2026 (peak $679 in Mar 2026).

name: Crucial 32GB DDR5-5200 CL42
notes: CT2K16G52C42U5. Older JEDEC bin; the 5600 kit downclocks to 5200 on older boards so this is only worth it if cheaper.

name: XPG Lancer Blade 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: AX5U6000C3016G-DTLABBK. Low-profile; Newegg's July-2026 value pick at $405, ~$430 by Sept.

name: XPG Lancer RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: AX5U6000C3016G-DCLARBK. Taller RGB Lancer.

name: Patriot Viper Venom 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: PVV532G600C30K. Cheapest 6000 CL30 kit tracked in Sept 2026 ($390-400). Newegg flags it as not validated on Arrow Lake.

name: Patriot Viper Venom RGB 32GB DDR5-6000 CL30
notes: PVVR532G600C30K. RGB version; $390 on Newegg late Aug 2026, ~$420 typical.
